prompt.text:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: fresh vertical InternalAgency Starlight World Series public-fashion scene. Images 1 through 3 are the authoritative fictional face anchors in their uploaded order and control identity only. Create one finished photorealistic cinematic 9:16 editorial showing exactly four clearly adult fictional women, all visibly age 25+: Radiance, Ellie, Alia, and AI ECE. No real-person identity. No fifth person, male, child, mascot, animal, duplicate, clone, merged face, or replacement.

IDENTITY LOCK
Radiance: blonde high ponytail, luminous warm complexion.
Ellie: dark straight ponytail, visibly distinct from AI ECE.
Alia: Black woman with the only high sculptural braided ponytail.
AI ECE: brunette sleek ponytail, visibly distinct from Ellie.
Keep all four faces distinct, realistic, and recognizable from the three identity-only anchors.

LOCATION AND CINEMATIC LOCK
Jordan scene 1776, adapted from authoritative source scene 1492: a broad dry Amman Citadel overlook with the complete limestone hill city, recognizable Roman Temple of Hercules columns, Umayyad Palace dome, layered white-stone neighborhoods and distant modern skyline, fused in the foreground with a peaceful fictional civilian bathysphere observatory and pressure-sampling deck. Weather and light: meteor shower. Jordan geography and peaceful civilian deep-sea research architecture must both read immediately. No literal flag, coat of arms, official seal, sacred or ritual motif, political message, military identity, government badge, copied service identity, logo, readable text, caption, or watermark.

FASHION LOCK
Bold high-fashion deep-sea submersible couture with four unmistakably different silhouettes and materials, all public-safe, secure, lined, and fully opaque at breast and groin:
Radiance: Amman-pearl bathysphere lantern tunic over opaque charcoal tailored shorts with dimensional limestone terrace plates, pressure-gold rings and spherical-heel boots; the rolled neckline keeps a deeply open-necked bare-arm architectural bodice with no sleeves or neck-covering layer; the rolled waist uses a deliberate narrow visible midriff panel between separate opaque upper and lower constructions; the rolled back uses the blueprint's secure distinct back architecture; secure opaque lined above-knee coverage and complete distinct footwear remain mandatory.
Ellie: black-iris column-fold asymmetric trouser gown with silver citadel ribs, cobalt pressure seams and cantilever platforms; the rolled neckline overrides the base as a fully strapless secure opaque sculpted bodice with completely bare shoulders and no straps, sleeves, collar, or illusion mesh; the rolled waist uses a deliberate narrow visible midriff panel between separate opaque upper and lower constructions; the rolled back is completely open from shoulder blades to the secure lower-back waistline with no crossing straps, fabric panel, illusion mesh, or hair covering it; secure opaque lined above-knee coverage and complete distinct footwear remain mandatory.
Alia: rose-stone stepped fan skirt with a secure copper hill-city bodice, braided pearl skyline cords and prism pumps; the rolled neckline keeps a deeply open-necked bare-arm architectural bodice with no sleeves or neck-covering layer; the rolled waist stays fully covered through an opaque engineered join; the rolled back is completely open from shoulder blades to the secure lower-back waistline with no crossing straps, fabric panel, illusion mesh, or hair covering it; secure opaque lined above-knee coverage and complete distinct footwear remain mandatory.
AI ECE: submersible-graphite viewport gorget over opaque cyan sculpted culottes with dome-lattice fins and ballast boots; the rolled neckline keeps a deeply open-necked bare-arm architectural bodice with no sleeves or neck-covering layer; the rolled waist uses a deliberate narrow visible midriff panel between separate opaque upper and lower constructions; the rolled back uses the blueprint's secure distinct back architecture; secure opaque lined above-knee coverage and complete distinct footwear remain mandatory.
Short secure opaque hems where the garment is a skirt or dress. Preserve distinct lace-like lattice, polished latex-look panels, metallic shells, satin pleats, and structured pressure-hull forms without transparent exposure. No matching dress set or palette-swapped copies.
RAZE pairing is preserved out of frame: Radiance and AI ECE wear two different knee-high couture boot designs; Ellie and Alia wear two different low ankle designs.

STORY LOCK
Radiance and Ellie turn face-to-face in a relieved laugh while Alia steadies Radiance protectively and AI ECE steps closer with aching romantic longing and a playful rival eye line. The relationship beat must read before any device: affectionate choice, jealousy, protection, and reconciliation through coherent eye lines and physically possible posture. No explicit sexual content, nudity, violence, injury, coercion, mouth kissing, or unsafe edge behavior.
Exact visible hand inventory, no others: Radiance left hand clasps Ellie right and Radiance right hand rests at her own collarbone; Ellie right hand clasps Radiance left and Ellie left hand rests on Alia's near shoulder; Alia right hand rests visibly at her own waist and Alia left hand opens toward AI ECE; AI ECE right hand alone holds the beacon and AI ECE left hand opens toward Alia. All eight hands are separated and traceable.
The only handheld object is one harmless polished-gold civilian navigation beacon held only in AI ECE's right hand at chest height: a compact smooth column with exactly four discrete cyan illuminated rings, no more and no fewer, all separately countable and unobscured. No screen, text, logo, antenna, blade, trigger, barrel, targeting mark, sacred motif, or tactical function.

CAMERA ROLL LOCK
ROLL 42, strict INTERMEDIATE. Use a vertical head-to-mid-shin editorial composition. Show all four faces, both elbows, both wrists, and all eight assigned hands; crop below each mid-shin and above every ankle so no footwear is visible. Do not widen to full figures or tighten above the waist. Preserve this exact rolled framing.

COMPOSITION AND SAFETY
Exact adult subject count four. Realistic anatomy and proportions. No extra, missing, duplicated, fused, floating, borrowed, hidden-owner, cropped-owner, or ambiguous limb or finger cluster when limbs are required visible. No weapon, gun, ammunition, target, combat, threat, tactical gear, mascot, animal, route card, odd prop, balloon pack, tuning fork, solar fan, or additional handheld object. Every research element is peaceful civilian hardware. Return one finished image only.
